title: Other Coverage Losses on the Patient's Claims, Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
**Clause.** For a Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account whose coverage-terminated liability is discounted, the other coverage losses are the PR-27 patient-responsibility releases on the patient's Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) claims other than the claim that the account's most recent coverage-terminated posting names (by posting date, the first recorded on a same-day tie; when that posting names no claim, every PR-27 release counts). Two or more add 5 percentage points to the coverage-loss discount percent, exactly one adds 2.5 percentage points, and none adds none.

| PR-27 releases on the patient's other claims | Percentage points added |
|---|---|
| two or more | 5 |
| exactly one | 2.5 |
| none | none |

## Points of judgement

- The count is of releases, not claims: two PR-27 releases on one other claim count as two.
- Releases on the claim that the account's most recent coverage-terminated posting names are left out; every other claim of the patient is read.
- *Case (hypothetical).* The most recent coverage-terminated posting names claim A. The patient's claims show PR-27 releases on claim A (two), claim B (one) and claim C (none): one release counts, so 2.5 points.
- *Case (hypothetical).* The most recent coverage-terminated posting names no claim, and the patient's claims show three PR-27 releases: all three count, so 5 points.
